reader_label: Family-Aware-inspired residual MLP, fixed MPS runtime adaptation

changes: runtime head only; no threshold labels, head or loss
six structural features shared with the fixed-MPS Ridge comparator
local CUDA-Q MPS target instead of Quantum Rings
fold-local family classifier instead of unavailable external pretrained weights

claim_boundary: Predict warm get_state runtime at one fixed MPS configuration on the existing common core. This does not evaluate the original joint threshold/runtime method, approximation selection, or unseen-family transfer. The original joint Family-Aware method retains S83's unavailable status.

data.reduction: Reuse the hash-level median of session/member warm medians from the S85 loader, without remeasurement or new label reduction.
data.quality_policy: Include both finite quality-failed labels in runtime-only scoring, report quality-qualified 142-row metrics separately, and never use quality/status as a feature.
data.outer_folds: Unchanged C44 exact-QASM folds, counts 37/28/26/25/34. All aliases share a fold.

features.preprocessing: log1p then standardize using finite outer-training hashes only; zero standard deviation uses scale 1. Inner family-classifier fits use their own inner-training preprocessing.
forbidden: true held-out family as predictor input

family_signal.alias_policy: Build connected components of family names that co-occur for the same exact-QASM hash in the static panel; the sorted component names define one class. This uses identity metadata only and avoids choosing a favorable alias.
family_signal.class_vocabulary: Outer-training family components plus UNKNOWN. Never expand the classifier vocabulary from outer-test families.
family_signal.training_signal: Sort finite outer-training rows by exact hash and apply GroupKFold(n_splits=4, shuffle=False), with exact hash as group, to obtain cross-fitted predicted families for runtime-training rows. The inner classifier must not train on the hash it predicts. Emit its train/predicted hash lists and library version.
family_signal.test_signal: Refit the classifier on all finite outer-training hashes and predict every outer-test hash from structural features alone. The runtime predictor receives this prediction, never the test family metadata.
family_signal.inner_missing_classes: Classes absent from an inner-training fold cannot be predicted there; map its predicted class into the fixed outer-training vocabulary. Single-class inner fits emit that training class deterministically. UNKNOWN is reserved for unmapped classifier outputs and has a zero family correction; never assign UNKNOWN by consulting true held-out family metadata.
family_signal.report: Record outer-test family-classification accuracy and true family components absent from finite outer-training rows as separate diagnostics after inference. The primary split is exact-hash OOF, not a deliberate family holdout; do not assume finite training support solely from full-panel family support.

runtime_model.backbone: Linear(6,128), SiLU, Dropout(0.2), Linear(128,64), SiLU, Dropout(0.2)
runtime_model.family_branch: Embedding(number_of_outer_train_classes+1,64); two Linear(64,64)+SiLU layers; FiLM gamma/beta Linear(64,64). UNKNOWN bypasses this branch with zero family correction and identity FiLM.
runtime_model.output: Linear(64,1) + Linear(6,1) structural shortcut + zero-initialized Linear(64,1) family residual
runtime_model.equation: b=backbone(x); f=family_mlp(embedding(predicted_family)); h=b*(1+gamma(f))+beta(f); z=runtime_head(h)+shortcut(x)+family_residual(f). UNKNOWN uses h=b and zero family residual. z predicts log1p(seconds).
runtime_model.ablation: An identical family-agnostic backbone/shortcut disables the family branch; train both variants with the same folds, seeds, features and optimizer. For each fold/seed initialize the shared backbone, runtime head and shortcut once, copy those exact initial weights to both variants, then initialize the family-only branch; record a shared-initial-state digest.
runtime_model.seed_policy: Use each registered seed for all fits in its outer/inner fold; record seed/fold indices. Median three runtime predictions per hash, retain every seed output.
runtime_model.prediction: maximum(0,expm1(predicted_log1p_seconds)); overflow/non-finite output is a technical failure, never replaced by a chosen fallback

evaluation.row_set: The identical 144 finite-label hashes and unchanged C44 folds; separately report the 142 quality-pass intersection and the full 150-hash envelope.
evaluation.bootstrap: Paired exact-QASM cluster bootstrap; use the common comparison/seed contract in docs/benchmark_completion.md.
evaluation.checkpoint: Fold 0 technical QA only: exact hash/fold accounting, finite predictions, no train/test or classifier cross-fit overlap, CUDA evidence, fixed settings and both ablations/seeds. Continue folds 1-4 unchanged without inspecting metrics.

execution.authorization_basis: User requested the strong agent to complete M1-M6 so routine workers can execute scientifically justified benchmark adaptations.
requirements: Reuse the audited S85 input loader and frozen measurements

Acquire the shared Maestro timing lock and host-wide /tmp/qre-benchmark-gpu-lease.lock using nonblocking flock throughout CUDA preflight, fitting and inference; check no live timing worker and reuse S85 exclusive_compute_lock. No concurrent timing or second GPU training worker
Record CUDA/PyG environment and smoke-test evidence
Pin code/protocol/input hashes before fold 0; write new outputs only
Run all five folds after technical checkpoint passes
